title: Payments API 500s after deploy
symptom: payments-api returned HTTP 500 with NullPointerException after release 2.14; error rate jumped to 12%
resolution: Rolled back to 2.13, then shipped a hotfix adding a null check for the optional billing address field.

title: Checkout latency from Redis eviction
symptom: checkout-service timeouts reading session data; Redis evicted keys because maxmemory was reached
resolution: Raised Redis maxmemory, switched eviction policy to volatile-lru, and added a memory alert at 80%.

title: Search indexer stuck on poison message
symptom: search-indexer consumer lag growing on a single partition with repeated deserialization errors
resolution: Moved the malformed message to the dead-letter topic and resumed the consumer; added schema validation upstream.

title: Postgres connections leaked by report job
symptom: too many connections errors from orders-db; report-worker held idle-in-transaction sessions
resolution: Terminated idle sessions, restarted report-worker, and fixed the missing session close in the nightly report job.
